title: Unigue ores
description: Adds new ores to minecraft world
body:
### Unique ores

## End of Development. Reason: I'm switching to java. I'm not using Mcreator anymore.
Adds new unique ores to minecraft
with new loot from them.

Good for making miencraft world more various.

# Amten ore
- New ore which spawns form Y-56 to Y-0.
- You can mine it with iron pickaxe and above
- Drops amten shard

# Amten shard
- New item which drops from Amten ore
